text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 金色细手链。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: One isolated accessory product photo, ONLY 金色细手链. Pure white background, soft studio light, no person, mannequin, clothing or other accessories. A matching pair only if explicitly described. Match the accessory from the 上排中 outfit in the reference; ignore all other objects. Complete straps and chains uncropped; no text. Do not recreate the outfit.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
